title: Digital Health Interventions for Persons Display Values
description: Display values for Digital Health Interventions for Persons ValueSet codes. Generated from FHIR expansions. Keys are code fragments (the part after '#' in the canonical IRI). The full IRI can be reconstructed as system + '#' + code.

fhir:displays.description: Multilingual display values for ValueSet codes keyed by code fragment

^.+$.description: Display values for a specific code fragment by language

^[a-z]{2}(-[A-Z]{2})?$.description: Display value in the specified language (ISO 639-1 code)

1.1.3.en: Transmit targeted alerts and reminders to person(s)

1.1.4.en: Transmit diagnostics result, or availability of result, to person(s)

1.2.1.en: Transmit untargeted health information to an undefined population

1.2.2.en: Transmit untargeted health event alerts to undefined group

1.4.1.en: Access by the individual to own medical or summary health records

1.4.2.en: Self monitoring of health or diagnostic data by the individual

1.4.3.en: Active data capture/documentation by an individual

1.4.4.en: Access by the individual to verifiable documentation of a health event or health status

1.5.1.en: Reporting of health system feedback by persons

1.5.2.en: Reporting of public health events by persons

1.6.1.en: Look-up of information on health and health services by individuals
